# In-Depth Carrier Reviews for HNW Insurance: RLI vs. Markel Umbrella Policies \[2026\]


## Why Carrier Selection Matters for High-Net-Worth Umbrella Coverage


For high-net-worth households, picking an[umbrella insurance](https://www.coveragecat.com/insurance-types/umbrella-insurance) carrier is not just about price. The carrier's financial strength, claims-paying track record, and coverage flexibility determine whether a policy actually protects you when a lawsuit exceeds your primary auto or homeowners limits.


The legal environment makes this more urgent than it has ever been. In 2024, 135 corporate lawsuits produced jury awards exceeding $10 million, a 52% increase over 2023, with total nuclear verdict dollars reaching $31.3 billion, a 116% jump from the prior year.[(Insurance Journal, "Corporate Nuclear Verdicts Surged to New Record High in 2024, Report Says", 2025)](https://www.insurancejournal.com/news/national/2025/05/22/824792.htm) Verdicts exceeding $100 million hit a record 49 cases that same year, up from 27 in 2023, and the average nuclear verdict now exceeds $51 million.[(Sedgwick, "Inside the verdict: what is driving the rise in nuclear and thermonuclear awards?", 2025)](https://www.sedgwick.com/blog/inside-the-verdict-what-is-driving-the-rise-in-nuclear-and-thermonuclear-awards/)


At the same time, the U.S. minted more than 440,000 new millionaires in 2025 alone, according to the UBS Global Wealth Report 2026, and insurance specialists warn that many of those newly wealthy households carry policies designed for an earlier, leaner financial stage.[(Insurance Business Magazine, "America's wealth boom is creating a new generation of underinsured clients", 2026)](https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/us/news/excess-surplus/americas-wealth-boom-is-creating-a-new-generation-of-underinsured-clients-581075.aspx)


This is where[standalone umbrella insurance](https://www.coveragecat.com/insurance-types/umbrella/standalone-umbrella-insurance-policies) carriers enter the picture. Unlike traditional insurers that require you to bundle home and auto, standalone umbrella carriers, also known as monoline umbrella carriers, write umbrella policies independently. Your existing home and auto coverage stays in place, and the umbrella sits on top of it. Coverage Cat lets you compare these standalone umbrella insurance carriers in a single session, with instant quotes and no phone calls required.


## RLI Insurance Company: The Market Leader


RLI Corp. was founded in 1965 in Peoria, Illinois, with a focus on specialty and difficult-to-place risks that standard carriers frequently declined. Today, RLI Insurance Company is the largest personal umbrella writer in the United States and writes coverage in all 50 states.[(RLI Corp., "RLI Personal Umbrella - Get a quote or make a payment", 2026)](https://www.rlicorp.com/personal-insurance/personal-umbrella-insurance)


In February 2026, AM Best upgraded RLI's Financial Strength Rating to A++ (Superior), the highest rating AM Best awards, from A+ (Superior).[(AM Best, "AM Best Upgrades Credit Ratings for RLI Corp. and Its Subsidiaries", 2026)](https://news.ambest.com/pr/PressContent.aspx?altsrc=2&refnum=37057) AM Best attributed the upgrade to RLI's balance sheet strength, strong operating performance, and what the ratings agency described as "perpetual internal capital generation," which pushed policyholder surplus to $1.9 billion as of the third quarter of 2025.[(Reinsurance News, "AM Best upgrades ratings of RLI and its subsidiaries", 2026)](https://www.reinsurancene.ws/am-best-upgrades-ratings-of-rli-and-its-subsidiaries/)


The operational track record matches the rating. RLI posted underwriting income of $264.2 million for 2025 and a combined ratio of 83.6, its 30th consecutive year of underwriting profit.[(SEC, "RLI Corp 2025 Form 10-K", 2026)](https://www.sec.gov/ixviewer/ix.html?doc=/Archives/edgar/data/0000791826/000079182623000001/rli-20251231x10k.htm) For HNW buyers, that 30-year streak matters because it means RLI has not relied on investment income to offset underwriting losses, the way weaker carriers often do.


For a full breakdown of the carrier's history, product details, and customer experience, see Coverage Cat's[RLI Insurance Review](https://www.coveragecat.com/reviews/rli-insurance) .


### What RLI Covers


RLI personal umbrella policies provide liability coverage above and beyond existing homeowners and auto policy limits, covering bodily injury, property damage, certain lawsuits, and personal liability situations that underlying policies do not reach.[(Ibid.)](https://www.rlicorp.com/personal-insurance/personal-umbrella-insurance) RLI offers limits from $1 million up to $5 million per policy. For most HNW buyers, the $2 million to $5 million range is practical, and RLI writes those limits in every state.


Coverage Cat's recent weighted pricing data suggests many RLI $1 million umbrella quotes cluster around $675 to $775 in California and $775 to $875 in New York, with Texas and Washington typically landing in a similar or slightly lower band depending on household exposure.


One firm limitation: RLI caps personal umbrella coverage at $5 million per policy. Ultra-HNW clients who need $25-$500 million or more must stack multiple policies across carriers or access excess and surplus lines markets.


## Markel Specialty Insurance: The Strong Alternative


Markel was founded in 1930 in Richmond, Virginia, and built its reputation in specialty and surplus lines coverage. Its personal insurance division writes umbrella policies as a true standalone product, with no requirement to hold home or auto coverage through Markel or any affiliated carrier.[(Markel, "Custom Personal Insurance | Markel", 2026)](https://www.markel.com/us/personal-insurance)


AM Best affirmed Markel's Financial Strength Rating at A (Excellent) in November 2025, along with Long-Term Issuer Credit Ratings of "a+" (Excellent) for all members of the Markel North America Insurance Group.[(AM Best, "AM Best Affirms Credit Ratings of Markel Group Inc. and Its Subsidiaries", 2025)](https://news.ambest.com/PR/PressContent.aspx?altsrc=149&refnum=36790) Markel Group reported 2025 operating revenues of $15.51 billion, a 5% increase year-over-year, with adjusted operating income up 10% to approximately $2.3 billion.[(Markel Group, "Markel Group reports 2025 financial results", 2026)](https://ir.mklgroup.com/investor-relations/news/news-details/2026/Markel-Group-reports-2025-financial-results/default.aspx) That scale puts significant capital behind each policy.


Markel writes personal umbrella coverage in 43 states, not all jurisdictions. Buyers in states where Markel is unavailable typically find RLI as the primary standalone option.


For a detailed look at Markel's product terms, exclusions, and customer experience, see Coverage Cat's[Markel Personal Umbrella Insurance Review](https://www.coveragecat.com/reviews/markel-personal-umbrella-insurance-review) .


### How Markel Differs from RLI


Markel's underwriting appetite generally accepts higher-risk profiles, including households with prior losses or younger drivers, that RLI may decline. This makes Markel a practical alternative for buyers who cannot qualify under RLI's more selective underwriting standards.


Real-world pricing also favors standalone carriers over bundled options. A discussion on the White Coat Investor community documented one household's bundled State Farm umbrella premium rising 75% year-over-year, from $775 to approximately $1,350, which prompted a search for standalone alternatives. Markel's umbrella quote for the same limit came in at less than half the bundled premium.[(White Coat Investor Forum, "Markel Insurance - The White Coat Investor Forum", 2025)](https://forum.whitecoatinvestor.com/insurance/499808-markel-insurance) That gap is common when you compare monoline carriers against bundled pricing.


Markel caps personal umbrella limits at $5 million per policy, matching RLI's ceiling for most buyers. Coverage Cat's recent weighted pricing data shows many Markel $1 million umbrella quotes in New York clustering around $750 to $850, close to RLI's range in that market. In California and Texas, Markel often quotes in a similar roughly $700 to $825 band, though the actual figure shifts with each household's loss history and exposure profile.

### When to Choose RLI


RLI is the stronger choice when financial strength grade is a priority. The A++ rating from AM Best is the highest possible, and only a small number of U.S. insurance groups hold it.[(RLI Corp., "AM Best Upgrades Financial Strength Rating to A++ (Superior)...", 2026)](https://investors.rlicorp.com/news/news-details/2026/AM-Best-Upgrades-Financial-Strength-Rating-to-A-Superior-and-Revises-Outlook-to-Stable-for-RLI-Corp--RLI-Insurance-Co--Mt--Hawley-Insurance-Co--and-Contractors-Bonding-and-Insurance-Co-/default.aspx) RLI also writes in every state, which means it is available where Markel is not. Buyers with clean loss histories who want the most financially secure standalone carrier behind their policy will generally find RLI a strong fit.


### When to Choose Markel


Markel is a better fit when RLI declines due to risk factors such as prior claims, teen drivers, or other exposures that fall outside RLI's preferred underwriting profile. Markel's broader appetite means more households can access a standalone policy without reverting to a bundled option. For buyers in the 43 states where Markel writes, it often quotes competitively against RLI, and the A (Excellent) rating still reflects sound claims-paying ability backed by a $15.5 billion revenue company.


### A Note on Ultra-HNW Needs


Neither RLI nor Markel issues a single personal umbrella policy above $5 million. Households that need $10 million or more in total umbrella coverage must either stack two $5 million policies across separate carriers or access the excess and surplus lines market. This is a structural limitation of the standalone umbrella market, not a deficiency specific to either carrier. The[Monoline](https://www.coveragecat.com/reviews/monoline-insurance-review) platform is worth comparing for buyers who need flexibility at lower limits or who face difficulty qualifying with the two primary standalone carriers.

Florida consistently prices above other states for comparable limits. In California, New York, Texas, and Washington, each additional $1 million of coverage typically raises annual cost by roughly $125 to $175. Florida tends to step up faster, adding roughly $200 to $275 per additional million in many recent quotes.


The broader market context: carriers are also raising underlying auto liability requirements, often to $500,000 to $1 million, as a condition of writing any umbrella policy.[(Brown & Brown Insurance, "Umbrella & Excess Liability - 2026 Market Trends Report", 2026)](https://insights.bbrown.com/markettrends/personal-insurance/umbrella-excess-liability) This applies across standalone carriers, not just RLI and Markel, and is worth confirming before you buy.

### Who Should Compare HNW Insurance Carriers


Not every household needs a formal[high-net-worth umbrella insurance](https://www.coveragecat.com/insurance-types/umbrella/high-net-worth-individuals-and-umbrella-insurance) carrier comparison, but several profiles benefit most:


- Households with $1 million or more in net assets, including home equity, investment accounts, and retirement savings
- Rental property owners, who face liability exposure that a standard landlord policy does not fully cover
- Families with teen drivers, who statistically raise the probability of an at-fault accident
- Homeowners with pools, trampolines, or similar attractive nuisance exposures
- Individuals who frequently host large gatherings
- Newly wealthy households that have not updated coverage since a liquidity event or major asset gain


That last group is large and growing. The U.S. added over 440,000 millionaires in 2025 alone, and many still carry coverage sized for a leaner financial stage.[(Insurance Business Magazine, "America's wealth boom is creating a new generation of underinsured clients", 2026)](https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/us/news/excess-surplus/americas-wealth-boom-is-creating-a-new-generation-of-underinsured-clients-581075.aspx)


The nuclear verdict data makes the geographic case for higher limits. California, Florida, New York, and Texas collectively produce half of all nuclear verdicts in the country despite representing roughly a third of the U.S. population, according to the U.S. Chamber of Commerce Institute for Legal Reform.[(U.S. Chamber of Commerce Institute for Legal Reform, "Nuclear Verdicts: An Update on Trends, Causes, and Solutions", 2024)](https://instituteforlegalreform.com/research/nuclear-verdicts-an-update-on-trends-causes-and-solutions/) A $300,000 auto liability limit leaves a real gap against a $3 million or $5 million judgment, and a standalone umbrella policy is the most direct way to close it.
